{{Top|canon=Hover-stretcher}}
A '''repulsorlift stretcher''', '''repulsor stretcher''', '''repulsorlift gurney''', '''float gurney''', '''float bed''',<ref name="TFAD">{{JournalCite|6|To Fight Another Day}}</ref> '''grav-bed''',<ref name="CB">{{JournalCite|14|Crimson Bounty}}</ref> or '''grav-stretcher'''<ref name="SW">''[[SkyeWalkers: A Clone Wars Story]]''</ref> was a type of [[gurney]] equipped with [[Repulsorlift/Legends|anti-gravity]] technology that was used to carry the grievously injured or unconscious.

[[Chiewab Amalgamated Pharmaceuticals Company]]'s [[ECM-598 Medical Backpack]] contained a collapsible repulsorlift stretcher that could be used by one person and carry up to 150 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].<ref name="GFT">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]''</ref>
